card.name: Prepositions and routes before administration
card.fires_on: Two kinds of spot: the middle or end of route-of-administration words (intr-avenous, inject-able), and short place or basis prepositions like on and in (on mountain tops, born in the United States, built on orders).

modes.label: Route words
modes.description: The ending piece of intravenous or injectable, right before administration, infusion or suspension.
modes.example: In animal reproduction studies, intr<<avenous>> administration of pemetrexed to pregnant

modes.label: Place prepositions
modes.description: The words on or in that tie something to a location or legal basis.
modes.example: All persons born or naturalized<< in>> the United States and subject to the jurisdiction

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese words meaning located at or residing in, and weakly promotes unrelated rare pieces, so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the end of words like intravenous and injectable, and on small words like on and in that tie something to a place.
